quiet-luxury.label: Quiet Luxury
quiet-luxury.essence: A serene, quiet-luxury whole style characterized by organic curves, architectural fluting, natural stone veining, and warm layered ambient illumination.

bohemian.label: Bohemian
bohemian.essence: A warm, earthy bohemian sanctuary featuring rich timber, lush botanical greenery, handcrafted artisanal ceramics, woven rattan textures, and layered global textiles.

mid-century-modern.label: Mid Century Modern
mid-century-modern.essence: Warm, sophisticated mid-century modern aesthetic blending rich wood veneers, organic curves, fluted paneling, and ambient layered lighting.

art-deco.label: Art Deco
art-deco.essence: Opulent art-deco interior characterized by sophisticated dark woods, polished brass accents, fluted joinery, arched architectural geometry, and warm ambient illumination.

warm-minimalism.label: Warm Minimalism
warm-minimalism.essence: A serene, warm-minimalist whole style featuring organic curves, refined natural woods, earthy tones, and soft diffused lighting.

indo-contemporary.label: Indo Contemporary
indo-contemporary.essence: An Indo-contemporary sanctuary fusing clean modern architecture, rich natural wood, woven cane, brass accents, and traditional Indian motifs under warm layered lighting.

modern-contemporary.label: Modern Contemporary
modern-contemporary.essence: Sophisticated modern-contemporary space featuring warm integrated LED illumination, clean architectural lines, natural wood elements, and serene neutral earth tones.

japandi.label: Japandi
japandi.essence: A serene Japandi whole-home specification blending Scandinavian minimalism with Japanese wabi-sabi through natural wood textures, organic curves, and warm illumination.

scandinavian.label: Scandinavian
scandinavian.essence: Serene Scandinavian design featuring light wood, natural textures, clean lines, integrated warm illumination, and organic botanical elements.

biophilic.label: Biophilic
biophilic.essence: An immersive biophilic sanctuary featuring lush indoor foliage, organic wood textures, natural stone, and warm layered illumination.

coastal.label: Coastal
coastal.essence: A serene, sunlit coastal home featuring warm natural woods, woven rattan and cane, serene oceanic blues, soft brass details, and organic botanical motifs.

wabi-sabi.label: Wabi Sabi
wabi-sabi.essence: A serene, contemplative wabi-sabi sanctuary fusing organic weathered wood, tactile handmade ceramics, matte plaster, and warm diffuse illumination for grounded living.

industrial.label: Industrial
industrial.essence: Moody industrial whole-home design featuring exposed brick, raw concrete, dark stained wood, and black metal framing under warm, integrated linear lighting.

neoclassical.label: Neoclassical
neoclassical.essence: Sophisticated neoclassical interior featuring classical architectural wall moldings, vertical fluted millwork, arched cabinetry, polished marble surfaces, warm layered illumination, and luxurious velvet upholstery.

traditional-south-indian.label: Traditional South Indian
traditional-south-indian.essence: A warm, rich traditional South Indian style featuring dark carved woods, woven cane, polished brass, and serene cultural artifacts.

rounds.question: Which room feels most like your kind of welcome?
Which kitchen would make everyday rituals feel better?
Where would you exhale at the end of the day?
How should your home introduce itself?
Which setting makes you want to gather longer?
Which wardrobe language would you live with?
Which composition has the texture you are drawn to?
No overthinking. Which space is simply you?
